title: Highest-weight critical-exponent lower bound for the symmetric limit-set Hausdorff dimension of strongly projectively convex-cocompact subgroups of SL(n,R)
author: Olivier Glorieux; Daniel Monclair; Nicolas Tholozan
work: Hausdorff dimension of limit sets for projective Anosov representations
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 10 (2023), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.241
difficulty_reason: Coornaert’s visual-boundary dimension theorem alone does not compare the Euclidean dimension of the symmetric projective limit set with the highest-weight critical exponent. The authors prove a uniform primal-dual boundary estimate from Hilbert cross ratios, supporting hyperplanes and angle bounds, controlling both point and tangent-hyperplane distances. This new geometric comparison supplies the required dimension inequality before the formal entropy and Hausdorff-dimension conclusion.
